en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj who said, 
‘I heard Abbad Al-Basry saying,

‘Ja’farasws was saying: ‘The Penalty (Hadd) would be staved off from him by the measurement of his share from her, and he would be struck with what is other than that, meaning regarding the man when he fell upon a slave girl, for him being a share in her’.
